name: v2-presigned-account-acl-swap-signs-joined
note: the signature is over the string to sign of a URL used with X-Amz-Acl: private and X-Goog-Acl: public-read; X-Account- sorts before X-Amz-, so the swap keeps the joined line and verifies, while radosgw's canned ACL becomes public-read; rgw-go's Verifier refuses the request once it has authenticated (relabelledDirective)
